TUR.scope: Turkey 1992: consolidated central government budget (general and annexed budgets) at about 6,872 TL per US$, plus social security institutions (SSK, Emekli Sandigi, Bag-Kur) estimated. Funds, state enterprises and local governments not covered. Tax mix from 1992 shares (income-based 49.5%, expenditure-based 49.6%, wealth 0.9%).

mechs.name: Income tax (wage withholding and declared income)
mechs.note: Income tax, about 38.6% of 1992 tax revenue (income-based taxes 49.5%). Scale 25% to 50%, bands approximate.

mechs.name: Corporate tax
mechs.note: Corporate tax at 46% plus fund levies, about 10.9% of 1992 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Domestic value-added tax (KDV)
mechs.note: Domestic VAT, about 17.5% of 1992 tax revenue; general rate approximate.

mechs.name: Excise, import VAT, stamp and other goods and services taxes
mechs.note: Fuel and other excises, VAT on imports, stamp, banking and insurance taxes, about 14.0% of 1992 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Foreign trade taxes (customs and import levies)
mechs.note: Taxes on foreign trade, about 18.1% of 1992 tax revenue.

mechs.name: Non-tax revenue
mechs.note: Property income, state monopolies, fees, fines, annexed budgets and other non-tax receipts, 1992 consolidated budget (18.7% of revenue).

mechs.name: Social security contributions (estimated)
mechs.note: SSK, Emekli Sandigi and Bag-Kur own income, estimated for 1992 from the 1991 total (29.3 trn TL), less budget transfers.
